source_publication: The recovery note was published. The subsequent policy_v6.gd write was blocked by the connector safety check; the policy is preserved locally, not claimed remotely available.
interpretation: Predeclared discovery only. Seed pairing is by run index; downstream RNG consumption can differ. Generic balanced RandomBuild controls are screening controls, not the signed P9 arm or a substitute for route-matched confirmation.
decision: No P9 candidate selected. Setup support improved planned play but cheap unconditional support also benefited RandomBuild. Next discovery tests weak-alone/strong-in-combination designs rather than further general buffs.
method_correction_for_next_design: The first screening heuristic required a 35pp gap for every route. That is stricter than the signed C2 top-cell gap and is not P9 acceptance. Preserve this freeze; future designs must distinguish top-cell separation, per-package viability floor, and the original C1 four-cell requirement. Three named controllers do not prove four viable descriptor cells.
